name: php-baremetal/ext-display
description: Display surface for php-baremetal: framebuffer, drawing primitives, bitmap fonts and region flush behind Baremetal\Output\Display. Panel drivers plug in through display_panel_ops_t.

display-surface.description: The drawing surface of Baremetal\Output\Display (the drawing methods and flush()). false: a driver attaches without it and nothing is allocated for it (on a turned MIPI-DSI panel a framebuffer of width x height x 2 bytes of PSRAM), a renderer such as Slate still drives the panel, and every drawing method throws.
